long_biography.plain_text:
Separating Plains Resources' upstream assets created the public producer that James C. Flores would lead for more than a decade. The transaction extended a pattern established after college, when he founded a petroleum land-management firm and then partnered childhood friend Billy Rucks. An oil-price collapse pushed their business towards exploration and production.

A geologist's son from Lafayette, Flores studied corporate finance and petroleum land management at LSU; that blend remained visible in a career built around deals and operations. He used acquisitions, mergers and spin-offs to create larger energy platforms, eventually joining Freeport-McMoRan as its oil-and-gas chief after it bought Plains Exploration & Production. He now chairs and leads Sable Offshore, combining the chief-executive role with co-founder ownership.
